audit.evidence: Materialize focuses on providing correct and consistent answers with minimal latency, and does not ask you to accept either approximate answers or eventual consistency. This guarantee holds even when joining data from multiple upstream systems. Whenever Materialize answers a query, that answer is the correct result on some specific (and recent) version of your data. Materialize does all of this by recasting your SQL queries as *dataflows*, which can react efficiently to changes in your data as they happen. ／ Materialize can read data directly from a PostgreSQL or MySQL replication stream, from Kafka (and other Kafka API-compatible systems like Redpanda), or from SaaS applications via webhooks. ／ Once you've got the data in, define views and perform reads via the PostgreSQL protocol.
